# Per dynasty perk: add/remove effects (left click adds, right click removes),

DI_perk_add_blood_legacy_1 = {
    scope = character

    is_shown = {
        var:DI_dynasty_selected_dynasty = {
            NOT = { has_dynasty_perk = blood_legacy_1 }
        }
    }

    effect = {
        var:DI_dynasty_selected_dynasty = {
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_dynasty_perk = blood_legacy_1 } }
                # free-edit mode: grant first, then refund the EXACT engine
                # charge (inside dynasty scope; gate checks root = player character)
                if = {
                    limit = { root = { has_variable = DI_legacy_editor_free_mode } }
                    save_scope_value_as = { name = DI_renown_before value = dynasty_prestige }
                    add_dynasty_perk = blood_legacy_1
                    add_dynasty_prestige = { value = scope:DI_renown_before subtract = dynasty_prestige }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { dynasty_prestige >= { value = 250 add = { value = dynasty_num_unlocked_perks multiply = 500 } } }
                    add_dynasty_perk = blood_legacy_1
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

        }
    }

            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_dynasty_perk = guile_legacy_2 } }
                # free-edit mode: grant first, then refund the EXACT engine
                # charge (inside dynasty scope; gate checks root = player character)
                if = {
                    limit = { root = { has_variable = DI_legacy_editor_free_mode } }
                    save_scope_value_as = { name = DI_renown_before value = dynasty_prestige }
                    add_dynasty_perk = guile_legacy_2
                    add_dynasty_prestige = { value = scope:DI_renown_before subtract = dynasty_prestige }
                }

                    limit = { dynasty_prestige >= { value = 250 add = { value = dynasty_num_unlocked_perks multiply = 500 } } }
                    add_dynasty_perk = guile_legacy_2
                }
            }
        }
    }

    scope = character

    is_shown = {
        var:DI_dynasty_selected_dynasty = {
            NOT = { has_dynasty_perk = kin_legacy_3 }
        }
    }

    effect = {
        var:DI_dynasty_selected_dynasty = {
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_dynasty_perk = kin_legacy_3 } }
                # free-edit mode: grant first, then refund the EXACT engine
                # charge (inside dynasty scope; gate checks root = player character)
                if = {
                    limit = { root = { has_variable = DI_legacy_editor_free_mode } }
                    save_scope_value_as = { name = DI_renown_before value = dynasty_prestige }
                    add_dynasty_perk = kin_legacy_3
                    add_dynasty_prestige = { value = scope:DI_renown_before subtract = dynasty_prestige }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { dynasty_prestige >= { value = 250 add = { value = dynasty_num_unlocked_perks multiply = 500 } } }
                    add_dynasty_perk = kin_legacy_3
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

    is_shown = {

        }
    }

    effect = {
        var:DI_dynasty_selected_dynasty = {
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_dynasty_perk = fp1_adventure_legacy_3 } }
                # free-edit mode: grant first, then refund the EXACT engine
                # charge (inside dynasty scope; gate checks root = player character)
                if = {
                    limit = { root = { has_variable = DI_legacy_editor_free_mode } }
                    save_scope_value_as = { name = DI_renown_before value = dynasty_prestige }
                    add_dynasty_perk = fp1_adventure_legacy_3
                    add_dynasty_prestige = { value = scope:DI_renown_before subtract = dynasty_prestige }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { dynasty_prestige >= { value = 250 add = { value = dynasty_num_unlocked_perks multiply = 500 } } }
                    add_dynasty_perk = fp1_adventure_legacy_3
                }
            }
        }

                limit = { has_dynasty_perk = fp2_coterie_legacy_2 }
                remove_dynasty_perk = fp2_coterie_legacy_2
            }
        }
    }

DI_perk_add_fp2_coterie_legacy_3 = {
    scope = character

    is_shown = {
        var:DI_dynasty_selected_dynasty = {
            NOT = { has_dynasty_perk = fp2_coterie_legacy_3 }
        }
    }

    effect = {
        var:DI_dynasty_selected_dynasty = {
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_dynasty_perk = fp2_coterie_legacy_3 } }
                # free-edit mode: grant first, then refund the EXACT engine
                # charge (inside dynasty scope; gate checks root = player character)
                if = {
                    limit = { root = { has_variable = DI_legacy_editor_free_mode } }
                    save_scope_value_as = { name = DI_renown_before value = dynasty_prestige }
                    add_dynasty_perk = fp2_coterie_legacy_3
                    add_dynasty_prestige = { value = scope:DI_renown_before subtract = dynasty_prestige }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { dynasty_prestige >= { value = 250 add = { value = dynasty_num_unlocked_perks multiply = 500 } } }
                    add_dynasty_perk = fp2_coterie_legacy_3
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

                limit = { NOT = { has_dynasty_perk = ce1_legitimacy_legacy_3 } }
                # free-edit mode: grant first, then refund the EXACT engine
                # charge (inside dynasty scope; gate checks root = player character)
                if = {
                    limit = { root = { has_variable = DI_legacy_editor_free_mode } }
                    save_scope_value_as = { name = DI_renown_before value = dynasty_prestige }
                    add_dynasty_perk = ce1_legitimacy_legacy_3
                    add_dynasty_prestige = { value = scope:DI_renown_before subtract = dynasty_prestige }

                    add_dynasty_perk = ce1_legitimacy_legacy_3
                }
            }
        }
    }

DI_track_add_all_blood_legacy_track = {
    scope = character

    is_shown = {
        var:DI_dynasty_selected_dynasty = {
            NOT = { blood_legacy_track_perks >= 5 }
        }
    }

    effect = {
        var:DI_dynasty_selected_dynasty = {
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_dynasty_perk = blood_legacy_1 } }
                if = {
                    limit = { root = { has_variable = DI_legacy_editor_free_mode } }
                    save_scope_value_as = { name = DI_renown_before value = dynasty_prestige }
                    add_dynasty_perk = blood_legacy_1
                    add_dynasty_prestige = { value = scope:DI_renown_before subtract = dynasty_prestige }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { dynasty_prestige >= { value = 250 add = { value = dynasty_num_unlocked_perks multiply = 500 } } }
                    add_dynasty_perk = blood_legacy_1
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_dynasty_perk = blood_legacy_2 } }
                if = {
                    limit = { root = { has_variable = DI_legacy_editor_free_mode } }
                    save_scope_value_as = { name = DI_renown_before value = dynasty_prestige }
                    add_dynasty_perk = blood_legacy_2
                    add_dynasty_prestige = { value = scope:DI_renown_before subtract = dynasty_prestige }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { dynasty_prestige >= { value = 250 add = { value = dynasty_num_unlocked_perks multiply = 500 } } }
                    add_dynasty_perk = blood_legacy_2
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_dynasty_perk = blood_legacy_3 } }
                if = {
                    limit = { root = { has_variable = DI_legacy_editor_free_mode } }
                    save_scope_value_as = { name = DI_renown_before value = dynasty_prestige }
                    add_dynasty_perk = blood_legacy_3
                    add_dynasty_prestige = { value = scope:DI_renown_before subtract = dynasty_prestige }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { dynasty_prestige >= { value = 250 add = { value = dynasty_num_unlocked_perks multiply = 500 } } }
                    add_dynasty_perk = blood_legacy_3
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_dynasty_perk = blood_legacy_4 } }
                if = {
                    limit = { root = { has_variable = DI_legacy_editor_free_mode } }
                    save_scope_value_as = { name = DI_renown_before value = dynasty_prestige }
                    add_dynasty_perk = blood_legacy_4
                    add_dynasty_prestige = { value = scope:DI_renown_before subtract = dynasty_prestige }
                }
                else_if = {

            NOT = { kin_legacy_track_perks >= 5 }
        }
    }

        var:DI_dynasty_selected_dynasty = {

            NOT = { fp2_urbanism_legacy_track_perks >= 5 }
        }
    }

    effect = {
        var:DI_dynasty_selected_dynasty = {
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_dynasty_perk = fp2_urbanism_legacy_1 } }
                if = {
                    limit = { root = { has_variable = DI_legacy_editor_free_mode } }
                    save_scope_value_as = { name = DI_renown_before value = dynasty_prestige }
                    add_dynasty_perk = fp2_urbanism_legacy_1
                    add_dynasty_prestige = { value = scope:DI_renown_before subtract = dynasty_prestige }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { dynasty_prestige >= { value = 250 add = { value = dynasty_num_unlocked_perks multiply = 500 } } }
                    add_dynasty_perk = fp2_urbanism_legacy_1
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_dynasty_perk = fp2_urbanism_legacy_2 } }
                if = {
                    limit = { root = { has_variable = DI_legacy_editor_free_mode } }
                    save_scope_value_as = { name = DI_renown_before value = dynasty_prestige }
                    add_dynasty_perk = fp2_urbanism_legacy_2
                    add_dynasty_prestige = { value = scope:DI_renown_before subtract = dynasty_prestige }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { dynasty_prestige >= { value = 250 add = { value = dynasty_num_unlocked_perks multiply = 500 } } }
                    add_dynasty_perk = fp2_urbanism_legacy_2
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_dynasty_perk = fp2_urbanism_legacy_3 } }
                if = {
                    limit = { root = { has_variable = DI_legacy_editor_free_mode } }
                    save_scope_value_as = { name = DI_renown_before value = dynasty_prestige }
                    add_dynasty_perk = fp2_urbanism_legacy_3
                    add_dynasty_prestige = { value = scope:DI_renown_before subtract = dynasty_prestige }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { dynasty_prestige >= { value = 250 add = { value = dynasty_num_unlocked_perks multiply = 500 } } }
                    add_dynasty_perk = fp2_urbanism_legacy_3
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_dynasty_perk = fp2_urbanism_legacy_4 } }
                if = {
                    limit = { root = { has_variable = DI_legacy_editor_free_mode } }
                    save_scope_value_as = { name = DI_renown_before value = dynasty_prestige }
                    add_dynasty_perk = fp2_urbanism_legacy_4
                    add_dynasty_prestige = { value = scope:DI_renown_before subtract = dynasty_prestige }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { dynasty_prestige >= { value = 250 add = { value = dynasty_num_unlocked_perks multiply = 500 } } }
                    add_dynasty_perk = fp2_urbanism_legacy_4
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_dynasty_perk = fp2_urbanism_legacy_5 } }
                if = {
                    limit = { root = { has_variable = DI_legacy_editor_free_mode } }
                    save_scope_value_as = { name = DI_renown_before value = dynasty_prestige }
                    add_dynasty_perk = fp2_urbanism_legacy_5
                    add_dynasty_prestige = { value = scope:DI_renown_before subtract = dynasty_prestige }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { dynasty_prestige >= { value = 250 add = { value = dynasty_num_unlocked_perks multiply = 500 } } }
                    add_dynasty_perk = fp2_urbanism_legacy_5
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_track_add_all_ep3_administrative_legacy_track = {
    scope = character

    is_shown = {
        var:DI_dynasty_selected_dynasty = {
            NOT = { ep3_administrative_legacy_track_perks >= 5 }
        }
    }

    effect = {
        var:DI_dynasty_selected_dynasty = {
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_dynasty_perk = ep3_administrative_legacy_1 } }
                if = {
                    limit = { root = { has_variable = DI_legacy_editor_free_mode } }
                    save_scope_value_as = { name = DI_renown_before value = dynasty_prestige }
                    add_dynasty_perk = ep3_administrative_legacy_1
                    add_dynasty_prestige = { value = scope:DI_renown_before subtract = dynasty_prestige }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { dynasty_prestige >= { value = 250 add = { value = dynasty_num_unlocked_perks multiply = 500 } } }
                    add_dynasty_perk = ep3_administrative_legacy_1
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_dynasty_perk = ep3_administrative_legacy_2 } }

                    add_dynasty_perk = ep3_administrative_legacy_2
                    add_dynasty_prestige = { value = scope:DI_renown_before subtract = dynasty_prestige }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { dynasty_prestige >= { value = 250 add = { value = dynasty_num_unlocked_perks multiply = 500 } } }
                    add_dynasty_perk = ep3_administrative_legacy_2
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_dynasty_perk = ep3_administrative_legacy_3 } }
                if = {
                    limit = { root = { has_variable = DI_legacy_editor_free_mode } }

                    add_dynasty_perk = ep3_administrative_legacy_3
                    add_dynasty_prestige = { value = scope:DI_renown_before subtract = dynasty_prestige }

                else_if = {
                    limit = { dynasty_prestige >= { value = 250 add = { value = dynasty_num_unlocked_perks multiply = 500 } } }
                    add_dynasty_perk = ep3_administrative_legacy_3
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_dynasty_perk = ep3_administrative_legacy_4 } }
                if = {
                    limit = { root = { has_variable = DI_legacy_editor_free_mode } }
                    save_scope_value_as = { name = DI_renown_before value = dynasty_prestige }
                    add_dynasty_perk = ep3_administrative_legacy_4
                    add_dynasty_prestige = { value = scope:DI_renown_before subtract = dynasty_prestige }

                else_if = {

                    add_dynasty_perk = ep3_administrative_legacy_5
                    add_dynasty_prestige = { value = scope:DI_renown_before subtract = dynasty_prestige }

                }
            }

    scope = character

    effect = {
        var:DI_dynasty_selected_dynasty = {
            if = {
